label: Data report (Python + pandas)
description: Load a CSV, clean it, chart it and write an HTML report, with Python and pandas.
task: Set up a data report project in Python in this empty folder. Create pyproject.toml (Python 3.11 or later) with pandas and matplotlib, and pytest as a dev dependency; data/sample.csv with a small made-up example dataset; report/load.py (read and clean the data, with typed columns), report/charts.py (a line chart and a bar chart saved under out/), and report/build.py, which writes out/report.html with a summary table and the charts. Add tests/test_load.py for the cleaning. Add a .gitignore for .venv, __pycache__ and out/, and a README.md that says how to create a virtual environment, install, swap in real data, build the report (python -m report.build) and test it (pytest).
